claim: Patchline ships a measured ten-thousand-repository activation funnel with retention and expansion metrics. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the retention claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make ten-thousand-repo-funnel-gate`.
